hooks.command: fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); echo "$fp" | grep -qE 'playbooks/.*/PLAYBOOK\.md|standards/connector-registry\.json|standards/snippet-registry\.json|projects/.*/decisions\.json' && cd /workspaces/mulesoft-bmad-planning && node scaffold/generate-capabilities.js 2>/dev/null || true

fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); echo "$fp" | grep -q 'connector-registry.json' && cd /workspaces/mulesoft-bmad-planning && node standards/build-connector-index.js 2>/dev/null || true

fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); echo "$fp" | grep -qE '\.html$' && echo "$fp" | grep -qv 'node_modules' && cd /workspaces/mulesoft-bmad-planning && node commons/branding/lint-html.js "$fp" 2>&1 || true

fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); (echo "$fp" | grep -qE 'firebase/public/.*\.html$|projects/.*/intake/.*\.html$') && (echo "$fp" | grep -qv 'node_modules') && node /workspaces/mulesoft-bmad-planning/commons/branding/lint-html.js "$fp" > /dev/null 2>&1 && bash /workspaces/mulesoft-bmad-planning/firebase/deploy.sh 2>&1 | tail -8 || true
